## Gap ID
API-011 / ARCH-002 (related)

## Source
gap-analysis-api-interface, gap-analysis-architecture

## Description
The REST API's campaign creation endpoint only supports `LocalExecutor`. HPC/cloud campaigns (Slurm, AWS Batch) must still be launched via CLI. This prevents PAT-compatible remote submission.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/api/` — endpoints call Campaign with default executor
- `--executor` flag only available in CLI

## Severity
Critical

## Recommended Mitigation
Extend the API campaign creation endpoint to accept an `executor` parameter and support all executor types. This is the highest-value near-term addition for PAT parity.

## Labels
gap-analysis, api, executor, remote-execution, critical
